summary.en: Conan discovers that, five years before, a man was killed in a "perfect crime" by the man who had killed himself, with the initials "T.K." Conan uses this clue, as well as other clues via help from an old boat rental owner, to deduce how the lawyer was killed. He then visits the old home where the man who was killed five years before lived with his mother and his younger brother, and gets information from an old lady there, and discovers a dog house sign that says "Johann". Conan had finally figured it out who the real murderer is.
